title: Changing a work order's rep or customer never touches the customers
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Three active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A}, {Sales-rep-B} and {Sales-rep-C}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able, {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able and {Sales-rep-C} is ZZAUTOTEST Cara Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has {Sales-rep-A} as its one sales representative; customer {Customer-B} has {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet and {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Other.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its one "Sales Representative" field reads {Sales-rep-A} (copied from {Customer-A} when it was created).
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Change the work order's Sales Representative to {Sales-rep-C}.
  2. Change the work order's customer to {Customer-B}.
  3. Open {Customer-A}'s page.
  4. Change {Customer-B}'s Sales Representative to {Sales-rep-A} in Edit Customer and save, then open {Work-order-1} again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the work order reads {Sales-rep-C}.
  • Step 2: the work order still reads {Sales-rep-C}; it does not take {Customer-B}'s {Sales-rep-B}.
  • Step 3: {Customer-A} still shows {Sales-rep-A}.
  • Step 4: {Work-order-1} still reads {Sales-rep-C}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S4-R28, S4-R32, S4-R30, read 19 Oct 2026. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R28: “The customer's representatives are copied only when the work order or part sale is created. Changing the customer on an existing work order or part sale never changes its representatives.”
  • S4-R32: “Picking a person, or "Unassigned", on a work order or part sale changes only that work order or part sale, never its customer.”
  • S4-R30: “Changing a customer's representatives never changes its existing work orders or part sales. Only work orders and part sales created afterwards start with the new choice.”

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), page 2 (cited by the story), export read 19 Oct 2026, used for on-screen labels; the look itself is checked in the "Design — how it looks" cases.
